The `spdx-2.3.1-schema.json` fixture is the SPDX 2.3.1 JSON schema from
https://github.com/spdx/spdx-spec/blob/v2.3.1/schemas/spdx-schema.json.
The SPDX schema is released under CC0-1.0 by the SPDX contributors. It is
vendored only so conformance tests run offline and validate against a fixed
schema revision.
